newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BLONDEAU TO JOIN SHEFFIELD WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BLONDEAU TO JOIN SHEFFIELD WEDNESDAY.

text.p: French international defender Patrick Blondeau will leave champions Monaco at the end of the season to join English premier league club Sheffield Wednesday.
"Patrick Blondeau will leave Monaco to play for Sheffield Wednesday next season," Monaco general manager Henri Biancheri told French radio on Saturday.
The 29-year-old Blondeau last week denied he would join Marseille, where he was born, adding he would join either Sheffield Wednesday or an Italian team.
Biancheri did not give any details about the transfer.
